---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or musical feature for the Expressive Control ecosystem
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: []
---

### Is your feature request related to a problem or musical need?
A clear and concise description of the motivation (e.g. *"I'm missing a microtonal Arabic scale mode when performing..."* or *"I want to route pitch-bend to MPE pressure..."*).

### Describe the Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how you envision the feature working.

### Target Component
- [ ] UI / Display Ergonomics (Slint touch/encoder interface)
- [ ] Musical DSP / Mapping logic (scales, quantization, pitch-bend)
- [ ] Transport & Protocols (MIDI 2.0, USB-MIDI, BLE, OSC)
- [ ] Hardware Peripherals (Sensors, Rotary Encoders, Buttons)
- [ ] Tooling / Web Flasher

### Describe Alternatives You've Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Additional Context
Add any other context, architectural thoughts, or musical references here.
